text: With seconds left, they crowd the front. Space opens behind their line.
A late surge pins the team back, but the far route is clear.
Their aggressive chase leaves an unmarked lane to the finish.
They commit everyone to pressure; a quick switch could escape it.
The crowd rises as the opponent closes in. There is room beyond the press.
A rushed late attack leaves their rear coverage thin.
The opponent holds a compact shape and waits for a rushed decision.
The clock is nearly gone. They refuse to chase and protect their positions.
They let the team have the ball, hoping impatience opens a mistake.
A quiet final stretch hides a trap: they wait for an unsupported push.
Their defence stays still. Drawing them out could open a route.
They protect the lead without pressing; patience must be answered with a plan.
A late formation change spreads them wide and opens the middle.
Their wings stretch the field; the central route is briefly unguarded.
They chase the outside lanes while the centre has fewer defenders.
Seconds remain and both sides drift wide, leaving a narrow middle gap.
A wide overlap draws their coverage away from the centre.
The last play pulls them apart; controlling the pace through the middle could help.
